title: NNSA accepted capacity: bounded September 24 decision
summary: The September 24 review retrieved the April 2026 draft environmental assessment and a dated NNSA announcement of a first qualified unit, but not the exact final accepted operating-capacity artifact required by this gate. The undated program overview still uses older capability wording; it must not override the dated unit announcement. The accepted-capacity signal remains In Review, without capacity or recurring-output admission.
evidence_note: This is a bounded public administrative-record review, not a finding that an acceptance record or capability does not exist. A draft environmental review, a planned final environmental decision and a first-unit qualification are different evidence objects. The October 2, 2024 announcement reports an October 1 event; neither date is a September 2026 event. No technical production methods were assessed or extracted. PDF cover-sheet and poster text were inspected, but image rendering was unavailable; visual or signature verification is not claimed. No login, records request, external contact, independent approval or publication occurred. The NNSA GAO-baseline and recurring-qualified-rate gates remain separate.
publication_effect: Candidate dated evidence update; accepted-capacity signal remains In Review. Capacity admission and Git-backed release held. Earlier receipts, source dates and separate NNSA decisions are not rewritten.
